_note: The ten streets of Addison. Each carries a character — outer loop, spine, arterial, newest phase — because those characters drive the difficulty ramp and Act III's flood geography.

streets.name: Bonerville
streets.character: The outer loop, original phase. Bigger lots, mature trees, old money, older residents. Its north arc backs directly onto the creek, which makes it the primary Act III flood street.

streets.name: Llama Alta
streets.character: Smallest homes, tightest lots — a short dense run in the south-west corner. Most friction, least sympathy from the board.

streets.name: Drahma
streets.character: A short run in the south-west corner, hanging off the bottom of the Bonerville loop. Two blocks and out — the smallest street on the map, and the only one that goes nowhere.

streets.name: Dimelest
streets.character: The interior. Standard mid-range Addison. Your baseline.

streets.name: Eyezetta
streets.character: The interior, immediately south of Dimelest and running into the spine. Standard mid-range Addison. Pairs with Dimelest as the baseline, which is how gameplan Day 3 routes them.

streets.name: Karaoke
streets.character: The north-south spine. Runs through the middle of the subdivision and exits south to the highway. Through-traffic, most visibility, board members watch this one.

streets.name: Bananalise
streets.character: The southern arterial. Runs the whole width of Addison and continues east out of the subdivision, so it carries traffic that has no business here. Everything is seen from Bananalise.

streets.name: Zingersoll
streets.character: Newest phase, east side. Builder-fresh, thin landscaping, lots of new move-ins so plenty of pods. The top of the block reaches the creek, so it takes Act III damage too.

streets.name: Goodish
streets.character: Newest phase, east side. Builder-fresh, thin landscaping. Runs south past the arterial into the newest section of all.

streets.name: Whistling Sparrow
streets.character: The far south-west corner, and the shortest street in Addison — one run, no through traffic, nothing beyond it. South of the arterial like Goodish, so it belongs to the newest section; unlike Goodish it never grew past its first block. The quietest address on the map, and the furthest from anywhere the Board looks.
streets._inferred: Phase and role are READ OFF THE MAP rather than authored: it sits south of Bananalise, which the file already treats as the newest section, and it is a short stub rather than a loop, a spine or an arterial. Change them if the intent was different — nothing else depends on these two fields except whether it is offered as a home street.
